description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the `FieldValidator` class in the `org.openmrs.validator` package. It tests validation logic for the `Field` model, ensuring validation rules are correctly enforced for different field properties such as name, selectMultiple, retired, and string length constraints.

classes.name: FieldValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the `FieldValidator` class related to validation of `Field` objects.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the `name` property of `Field` is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the `name` property of `Field` is an empty string.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsAllWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the `name` property consists only of whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfSelectMultipleIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the `selectMultiple` property is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the `retired` property is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all `Field` properties are correctly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when string fields are within expected length limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when string fields exceed their length constraints.
